verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a third-party UI component ecosystem: Vue's site claims a 'rich' ecosystem, there is a community curated list for components and tools, and a hands-on user praises Vuetify as a well-built material design component set. Its richness is only thinly evidenced, though, and other users say third-party component design 'varies wildly' and that nothing matches React's Material UI. Missing for 10: documentation naming multiple pre-built UI component libraries, evidence of breadth beyond a single named library (Vuetify), and consistent quality reports across libraries.
